`engine.config.resources({ local?, trust? })` answering the resolved package resources with whether each is enabled; `engine.config.setResource(...)` answering the changed entry, with two typed forms, because the two settings files do not hold the same thing. Global: `{ source, resource: { type, path }, enabled: boolean }`. Project-local: `{ local: true, trust?, source, resource: { type, path }, state: "inherit" \| "load" \| "unload" }`, the three states the project override has (`E/modes/interactive/components/config-selector.ts:30, 671-740`); a boolean cannot express `inherit`. The resource type is the engine's own (`E/core/package-manager.ts:82-97`)
